short.en: Open-crown visor brim. Ponytail-friendly, the coolest of the three.
short.zh: 空顶大帽檐，可以扎马尾，三款里最凉快。

long.en: An open-crown visor with a wide, soft brim. Nothing sits on top of your head, so it stays cool on the hottest afternoons and leaves room for a ponytail or a bun. Fold it, roll it, drop it in your bag.
long.zh: 空顶设计，大而柔软的帽檐。头顶完全不闷，最热的下午也凉快，扎马尾、盘发都能戴。可以折、可以卷，随手放进包里。

short.en: A taller open band with a soft, sculpted brim for full-face shade.
short.zh: 加高的空顶帽圈，帽檐有型，整张脸都能遮住。

long.en: A taller open band gives the Malibu a little more structure, and its sculpted brim shades the whole face. Breezy on top, polished from every angle: the one for the boat, the pool and the lunch after.
long.zh: 加高的空顶帽圈让马里布更有型，帽檐弧度能遮住整张脸。头顶透风，从哪个角度看都利落。出海、泳池边、之后的午餐，都是它。

short.en: Our classic closed crown. Full coverage, office to ocean.
short.zh: 经典封顶款，头顶全遮，上班出海都合适。

long.en: The hat the house is built on. A rounded closed crown and a generous brim give full coverage from your part line to your shoulders. Quiet enough for the office, made for the coast.
long.zh: 品牌的起点。圆润的封顶加上宽大的帽檐，从头顶到肩膀都遮得住。上班戴足够低调，海边戴刚刚好。
